name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. '0c' is a domain ID = index 0x0C of the per-event handler dispatch table at 0x51B91, NOT a Ghidra address residue. Descriptor corrected from '__unref_first_time' to '__ch4_orc_flee': the slot is LIVE, reached via the ch4 kill-drop path -- each of the 4 半獸人 (enemy_data 34, char_id 0x66, ch4 char_spawn_records[17..20]) carries pickup_kind=2 param=0x0C, so any orc's death dispatches consequence[0x0C]. The body arms AI mode 7 on those orcs (runtime slots 0x18..0x1B) and shows the page-3 'we quit' dialog -- the orc-group panic/flee beat. The earlier 'unref' verdict only scanned turn-event/tile-step hooks and missed the kill-drop path.
purpose: Chapter 4 orc-group panic/flee beat (dispatch table slot 0x0C, reached via the ch4 kill-drop path): first time any of the 4 半獸人 (enemy_data 34, records[17..20], each pickup_kind=2 param=0x0C) is killed, it arms AI mode 7 (charge_dash) on the orc group at runtime slots 0x18..0x1B and shows dialog page 3 (0x66 'we quit'), then consumes its trigger so later orc deaths are a no-op.
logic_summary: Gate: if tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] (byte at *data_fd2_field_map_tile_event_consumed_flags_ptr + 0x10) == 0, then (1) fd2_set_combat_aux_block_byte_d_low4_for_char_range(0x18, 0x1B, 7) -- writes low nibble 7 (AI mode charge_dash) into combat_aux_block[0xD] (absolute runtime_char offset 0x34, the per-event AI/dialog control flag) for the inclusive char range 0x18..0x1B (the 4 orcs, matching their page-2 portraits); (2) fd2_display_dialog_scene(data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page=3, 0xA0000, 0x140, 0xCD, 0x4C, 0x4A, 0x13, 1) = 0x66 '好可怕！不玩了！'; (3) set tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] = 1 to consume the trigger. Straight-line single-branch body; no RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL return value used. __CHK(0x28) is the compiler-injected stack-probe prologue; EBX is not touched.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: The uniform 1-arg cdecl argument supplied by the per-event handler dispatch table at 0x51B91 (the kill-drop recipient/killer idx). The body never reads it (declared (void)event_arg in src).
params.reason: Name reflects its role as the dispatch-table event argument; the table is uniform 1-arg cdecl and this handler ignores the value. No address residue, no placeholder; identical in src and Ghidra.

returns.semantics: No return value. Visible side effects (only on first orc death): AI mode 7 armed on chars 0x18..0x1B, dialog page 3 shown, and the consume byte tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10] set to 1.

comment_original_issue: Source comment (chevt1.c) previously stated the slot was unreferenced / possibly cut content. Corrected: it is LIVE via the ch4 kill-drop path (the 4 半獸人 records[17..20] pickup_kind=2 param=0x0C), and identifies the beat as the orc-group panic/flee.
notes: Verified via disassemble_function (0x34594): PUSH 0x28 / CALL __CHK; MOV EAX,[0x53ad5]; MOVZX byte[EAX+0x10]; TEST/JNZ to RET; CALL 0x3419c(0x18,0x1B,7); 9-arg CALL 0x15f84 with [0x53a79]=data_fd2_current_chapter_text, page 0x3; MOV byte[EAX+0x10],1; RET. Disasm matches src operation-for-operation; no equivalence concern. Callee 0x3419c ORs the raw low-byte arg into the low nibble of combat_aux_block[0xD] (= abs offset 0x34) over an inclusive char range; value 7 = charge_dash AI mode. CLASSIFICATION CORRECTION (renamed unref_first_time -> ch4_orc_flee): the earlier 'unref/cut content' verdict was WRONG -- it only checked turn-event/tile-step hooks and missed that a spawn record's +0x16 pickup_kind==2 dispatches consequence[param] on death. ch4 char_spawn_records[17..20] are all enemy_data 34 (半獸人, char_id 0x66, race 2) with pickup_kind=2 param=0x0C (decoder-confirmed), so any orc's death dispatches this slot; the affected runtime slots 0x18..0x1B are the same orcs (their page-2 portraits use PORTRAIT_BY_CHAR 0x18..0x1B) and page 3 (0x66 '好可怕！不玩了！') is their flee line. get_function_callers still returns none; sole xref is DATA from the dispatch-table slot 0x51BC1 (the FDFIELD reference is runtime-computed, not a static xref). Rename verified byte-equivalent by eqcheck.
